name: Kossan Rubber Industries Bhd
overview: Kossan 今年通过拟收购新加坡和泰国的 Inout Enterprise 公司，将业务扩展至新的领域；同时完成印尼子公司 PT Kossan Setia Jaya 和休眠子公司 Aseptapak Sdn. Bhd. 的自愿清算。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长 48.8%，净利润同比增长 106.9%。
overview_en: Kossan expanded into a new area through the proposed acquisitions of Inout Enterprise in Singapore and Thailand, while completing the voluntary liquidation of its Indonesian subsidiary PT Kossan Setia Jaya and dormant subsidiary Aseptapak Sdn. Bhd. In the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue rose 48.8% year-on-year and net profit rose 106.9% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面进行了拟收购 Inout Enterprise 及两家子公司自愿清算的事项。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company proposed the acquisitions of Inout Enterprise and completed the voluntary liquidation of two subsidiaries this year.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 印尼间接全资子公司 PT Kossan Setia Jaya 于 2026 年 10 月 23 日完成自愿清算。
actions.text_en: PT Kossan Setia Jaya, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary in Indonesia, completed its voluntary winding-up on 23 October 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 对 2026 年 8 月 18 日公告的拟收购 Inout Enterprise 事项进行修订，更新财务资料。
actions.text_en: Amended the announcement dated 18 August 2026 regarding the proposed acquisitions of Inout Enterprise, updating the financial information.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟以 15,145,000 新加坡元（约 48,391,304 马币）收购 Inout Enterprise Pte. Ltd. 全部股权，并拟收购 Inout Enterprise (Thailand) Ltd. 全部股权。
actions.text_en: Proposed to acquire 100% equity interest in Inout Enterprise Pte. Ltd. for SGD 15,145,000 (approximately RM48,391,304), and proposed to acquire 100% equity interest in Inout Enterprise (Thailand) Ltd.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资休眠子公司 Aseptapak Sdn. Bhd. 完成成员自愿清算，并于 2026 年 3 月 18 日提交最终会议报告。
actions.text_en: Aseptapak Sdn. Bhd., a wholly-owned dormant subsidiary, concluded its members' voluntary winding-up, with the Return by Liquidator Relating to Final Meeting lodged on 18 March 2026.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟收购 Inout Enterprise Pte. Ltd. 和 Inout Enterprise (Thailand) Ltd. 全部股权，进入此前没有的业务。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed acquisitions of the entire equity interests in Inout Enterprise Pte. Ltd. and Inout Enterprise (Thailand) Ltd., entering a business not previously undertaken.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 印尼子公司 PT Kossan Setia Jaya 完成自愿清算，退出该子公司业务。
model_changes.text_en: Indonesian subsidiary PT Kossan Setia Jaya completed voluntary winding-up, exiting that subsidiary's business.
